method: Newton solve of the implemented packed-store fixed-point equation F(X)=X via (I-J2)*DXP = F(X)-X, J2 = FD Jacobian (amp 1e-5 of per-element scale, floor 1e-3) at X0V; per-variant MAP_F(IRFI(IV)). Diagnostic only; production solver untouched.

state.layout: 3 compressing depths x 5 active store slots x {P,M} channels
state.seed: X0V = 30-iterate fixed point of the refreshed map (warm-up)

fullw05.meaning: full sweep + FG_KNOP_REFRESH_V1; packs post-refresh store
fullw05.interpretation: refresh fully re-solves the lagged chain below FD noise; the composite map is a constant map -> committed field is seed-independent in this problem

swp_w05.meaning: sweep only, relaxed writes; packs post-sweep store

swp_w10.meaning: sweep only, unrelaxed writes; the raw lagged inner map
swp_w10.eigenvalue_note: J is nonzero but nilpotent: the slot-coupling graph is a DAG on this synthetic problem

cross_variant.note: relaxation preserves the fixed point exactly, as required for a consistent under-relaxed map

ablation.result: identical eigenvalue spectrum -> the packed-store map is not I_PREV-mediated

consistency.column_consistency: max |J1-J2|/(scale) ~ 0 on all variants -> affine to FD accuracy

nl_contraction_probe.note: dynamic contraction matches the FD eigenvalues: sweep map contracts at 1-omega, refreshed map kills perturbations in one step

key_findings: The implemented packed-store map is affine: one Newton step takes ||F(X*)-X*|| to ~2e-14 (swp_w05) and exactly 0 (swp_w10); a direct solve exists and is reachable in one shot.

On this synthetic problem the unrelaxed lagged Jacobian is nilpotent (rho=0): the wavelength-coupling graph is a DAG ending at the unwritten boundary slot. The rho~0.97 production stiffness is NOT reproduced here - that requires cyclic cross-depth donor chains or the |GAM|/DLN >> chi regime, absent in p1t1 geometry.
The relaxed map's eigenvalues are exactly 1-omega=0.5: relaxation is the only source of spectral radius on a nilpotent base map.

The true lagged fixed point sits 9.9e-7 (max elementwise) / 2.14e-6 (L2) from the production committed field X0V - the same order as the refresh's own truncation residual (8.6e-9 relative on |X|~70), so the refresh is converging on the same fixed point.
Newton on the refreshed map is trivial (J=0): the refresh already computes the seed-independent answer.
caveats: A map-level Newton solve accelerates the implemented fixed-point iteration; it is not identical to the Schur-complement solve of the per-cell transfer equations derived in sections 2-3, though their fixed points coincide when the map is affine.
The synthetic problem does not exercise the production-stiffness regime; results verify the mechanism, not the rho~0.97 case.
FD Jacobian noise floor (~1e-5 amplitude on |X|~70) limits eigenvalue accuracy to ~1e-6; nilpotence is inferred from eigenvalues below that floor, not proven to the last bit.
